order.code: const es=self.nearbyEnemies(); const r=es.filter(e=>self.distanceTo(e)<=self.range); r.sort((a,b)=>(a.type==='worker'?0:a.type==='knight'?1:2)-(b.type==='worker'?0:b.type==='knight'?1:2)||a.hp-b.hp); if(r.length)self.attack(r[0]); else {const e=es.filter(e=>e.type==='worker'||e.type==='agent').sort((a,b)=>self.distanceTo(a)-self.distanceTo(b))[0]; if(e)self.moveTo(e.x,e.y);else self.moveTo(8,8);}
